ingredient_vocab_id.description: Vocab id from vocab/form.json, or null when the label's main active is not in the vocabulary or cannot be read.

ingredient_label_text.description: The ingredient exactly as printed, even when ingredient_vocab_id is null. This is how an unsupported ingredient gets named back to the user.

form_vocab_id.description: Form id from the chosen ingredient's forms list. Null when the label does not state a form; NEVER guessed from the brand or the powder's appearance.

compound_dose_mg.description: Milligrams of the COMPOUND per serving as printed (the salt/hydrate mass, not the active moiety). Conversion to elemental happens deterministically in vocab.elemental_dose_range_mg, never here.

dose_unit_as_printed.description: The unit string as printed ('4400 mg', '5 g', '1 scoop'), so a reader can check the mg conversion.

servings_per_day.description: Servings per day if the directions state one. Null when unstated -- never assume 1.

is_multi_ingredient.description: True when more than one active is dosed (a blend/MIPS/stack). Decisive: invariant 7 refuses trials whose ingredient arm co-administers another active, so a blend is a different question from the isolated ingredient.

other_actives.description: Other dosed actives as printed. Empty when single-ingredient.

actives.description: label-v1.1: EVERY dosed active on the panel, main active included, as printed. Feeds the deterministic compatibility check; never a dose used for scoring.

certifications.description: label-v1.1: third-party seals and testing statements AS PRINTED. Claims, not verifications -- the UI says so.

is_supplement_label.description: False when the image is not a supplement label at all (a receipt, a person, a screenshot). Lets the caller say so instead of scoring noise.

unreadable_reason.description: Why a field could not be read: blur, crop, glare, language, no panel visible.

evidence_spans.description: Verbatim strings copied from the label that justify the fields above. Project convention: evidence spans on every model output.
